2226-2805-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2805-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kiri-Onna by paying its mana cost.
When Kiri-Onna enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

969-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6723-6791.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2493-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2493-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
2493-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Archaeomancer and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1011-2511-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2511-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2511-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

341-2350-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

112-3120-7426.easyPrerequisites: Mindsplice Apparatus has at least three oil counters on it.
112-3120-7426.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Mindsplice Apparatus, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

147-2292-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2292-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

1453-2387-3490-4478.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-4478.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

240-5256-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3518-4742.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1477-6972-7153.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1438-1506.easyPrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1438-1506.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1438-1506.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2034-2267-4094-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-4094-5220-6961.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

2665-2743-6924.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, removing a film counter from it and tapping it, copying Progenitor Mimic's trigger.
Resolve both triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

24-3901-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Wrathful Red Dragon instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-3901-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

4947-5078-6633-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

1315-1863-2173-4423-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
1315-1863-2173-4423-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
1315-1863-2173-4423-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

5189-5641-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5189-5641-6441.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

783-1399-1606-3457.easyPrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
783-1399-1606-3457.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

575-2482-2653-4121.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Birchlore Rangers.
When Birchlore Rangers dies, Yedora triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Birchlore Rangers enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2868-5551-5686.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2868-5551-5686.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Basalt Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.

Activate the Basalt Monolith token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 using the other Basalt Monolith token.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.

Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Training Grounds token, adding {U}.
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {1}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Training Grounds token, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 5.

771-1692-2239-4886.notablePrerequisites:
Wildfire Eternal does not have summoning sickness.
Helm of the Host attached to Ardent Elementalist.
An opponent cannot block Wildfire Eternal.
771-1692-2239-4886.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist with haste.
When the token Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Savage Beating to your hand from your graveyard.
Declare Wildfire Eternal as an attacker.
When Wildfire Eternal is not blocked, it triggers, casting Savage Beating from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {0}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Barrin.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Barrin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Barrin by paying {0}.
When Barrin enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sister of Silence.

Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.

Activate Urza's Bauble by sacrificing it.

Stormtide makes everything an island, choke prevents them from untapping.
Nature's Will can untap your lands.

Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.

Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
